gallery.title: File:2006 02 13 - College Park - Snowed In (3186053951).jpg
gallery.description: This is what I get for parking in the corner on top of a parking garage... I should've known that the plows would shove it all in front of my car.  Not just that, but it partially melted and then refroze, forming a block of ice such that I couldn't dig my way out.  I had to get a coworker to pick me up for the next couple days while it melted.

gallery.title: File:2006 04 03 - 2466 - College Park - Storm (3233360582).jpg
gallery.description: This was one of those storms that immediately recalls to mind the tornados that struck this city just a couple years earlier.  It was a pretty cool storm to watch from so high up.  These photos span an 8 minute period at around 5:30 pm -- if it weren't for the storm, the sun would've still been high above.
